description: Initial wall-clock speedup check at the original short generation length (150 new tokens), run twice: once before and once after fixing the deprecated Cache.crop() call form in _crop_cache.
interpretation: Cached was slower than non-cached in both runs at this short length; fixing the crop-call deprecation did not resolve it (if anything, slightly worse, within noise). This ruled out the crop-call form as the cause and motivated scripts/p5_kv_cache_profile.py to break down where the time was actually going. Superseded as the 'headline' number by p5_kv_cache_speedup_400_result.json once the length-dependence was understood -- see reports/v1.2_kv_cache.md.
